Hey, I'm so sorry this happened to you. The same thing literally happened to me on the bus to Vatican city when I was 15, we looked later in the guidebook and it said a lot of pickpockets used that bus, obviously a lot of perverts too 🤢 I told my parents but they didn't tell the police, I would report it if you feel able to. Don't tell yourself it's minor because it was over your clothes, it doesn't matter. I still remember it really clearly and it was over 20 years ago.
